versions.changelog: Fix security claims per audit: clarify network behavior, add SSRF blocklist details, add supply-chain traceability
Add blog post links to resources. Updated documentation.

Initial public release of decompose-mcp.

- Decompose any text or URL into classified semantic units (authority, risk, attention, entities, etc.), fully deterministic and offline.
- No LLMs required; uses rules-based processing for maximum speed, privacy, and predictability.
- Supports two main tools: decompose_text (for local text) and decompose_url (for fetching and decomposing web content).
- Extracts standards, dates, financial amounts, obligation levels, and more with configurable output.
- Zero external dependencies beyond Python; works offline with SSRF protections for URL fetching.
- Designed for pre-processing documents, compliance review, and structured data extraction.
